job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Forecasting
job.location: New York, NY or Pittsburgh, PA
job.pay_full: $182,800 – $247,300 a year base salary, supplemented by equity compensation

details.about: Duolingo has over 500 million users and is expanding into new subjects and markets. This Senior Data Scientist joins the Monetization Data Science team to run and improve Duolingo's foundational monetization (revenue) forecast, used for planning, goal setting and business strategy, working closely with Finance, Product and Strategy and delivering business-critical quarterly forecasts with the Finance team.
duties: Co-own forecast development and presentation with Finance; recommend, develop and validate methodological improvements
Compare forecasts against actuals through the quarter with fellow data scientists, analyse what drives deviations and share findings and next steps
Work with diverse stakeholders so forecasts reflect product development, big bets and business strategy
Turn complex analysis into clear narratives for senior leadership and cross-functional partners
Build systems and processes that keep forecasting robust, repeatable and easy to understand
needs: Applied industry experience building forecasts in messy real-world settings
A graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise in formal analytical techniques
Ability to connect technical results to real-world recommendations and turn business changes into technical requirements
Strong command of SQL, Python, AI analysis tools and data/analytics engineering ecosystems
nice: Financial analytics experience at a high-growth consumer tech, finance/banking or consulting company, including revenue forecasting
Experience at a public company with investor-grade reporting and forecasting
details.benefits: Salary range $182,800 – $247,300 a year; base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. The offered salary depends on work experience, skills and internal peer comparisons, and the range may change. Duolingo links to its employee benefits from the posting.
notes: Duolingo staff only email from @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com and never ask candidates for money, bank details or ID numbers
Interview accommodations are available on request
